name: TOTP Recovery Code Sign-In Success
summary: A returning user with a password-issued TOTP MFA challenge chooses recovery-code authentication, submits one valid unused recovery code, invalidates the lost authenticator enrollment, and establishes an authenticated application session with TOTP disabled pending re-enrollment.
finalOutcome: One valid recovery code and the password-issued MFA challenge are consumed, the lost authenticator enrollment is invalidated, TOTP is disabled until re-enrollment, and an authenticated application session is active.

sourceReferences.note: ConsumeRecoveryCodeAsync consumes one recovery code, replaces the remaining recovery-code blob, removes the authenticator secret, and disables TOTP until the user enrolls again.
Recovery-code sign-in now requires and consumes a password-issued MFA challenge bound to the same durable user.
Successful recovery proof is adapted to browser-session or mobile-token completion through the common proven-user session adapters.
Canonical recovery-code entry surface is defined; React Native has a partial presentation shell while Angular and functional client verification remain outstanding.
Recovery code remains an MFA recovery proof, never a standalone primary login credential. Successful recovery intentionally invalidates the lost authenticator so the user can re-enroll cleanly.
